description: Run this project's Java static-analysis tools — Checkstyle, PMD, and SpotBugs — and summarize every issue found (file, line, rule/check, message), grouped by tool. Maven: `mvn clean compile checkstyle:checkstyle pmd:pmd spotbugs:spotbugs`, reading `target/checkstyle-result.xml`, `target/pmd.xml`, and `target/spotbugsXml.xml`. Gradle (wrapper preferred, Kotlin DSL or Groovy): whichever of `checkstyleMain`, `pmdMain`, and `spotbugsMain` (the `com.github.spotbugs` plugin) the build actually defines, run with `--continue`, reading their XML reports under `build/reports/checkstyle/`, `build/reports/pmd/`, and `build/reports/spotbugs/`. Kotlin sources are not analyzed by Checkstyle or PMD (and SpotBugs only sees their bytecode) — for Kotlin code use `iru-kotlin-code-quality` (detekt + ktlint); a mixed Java/Kotlin project runs both. Invoke as `/iru-java-code-quality` to check the whole project, or `/iru-java-code-quality <path-or-class-name>` to scope the summary to a specific file/class — the underlying build always analyzes the whole project (none of these tools support a per-class selector), only the reported summary is filtered. Use whenever the user wants a lint/static-analysis pass called out separately from `iru-java-test`/`iru-java-coverage`, instead of running the full `mvn site`/`./gradlew check` build.
